key_insight: OCUPO makes concave utility reinforcement learning tractable with linear function approximation, achieving off-policy sample complexity of Õ(ε⁻²), up to a controllable projection error.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a sample-efficient route to objectives such as imitation learning and maximum-entropy exploration without explicitly estimating high-dimensional occupancy measures.
method: Exploit known low-dimensional features in bilinear MDPs to estimate occupancy measures through feature expectations.
Use model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO).
Reuse past trajectories through backward feature regression, with an extension to linear MDPs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical sample-complexity guarantees of Õ(ε⁻⁴) on-policy and Õ(ε⁻²) off-policy, but no empirical evaluation.
watch_item: Off-policy guarantees require suitable policy-class assumptions and retain a controllable projection error; practical performance is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Provably Efficient Concave Utility Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation
